evals.name: storefront-hero-direction
evals.prompt: Redesign the luxe fashion storefront home hero — avoid generic SaaS gradient + big number template. State design direction before code.
evals.expected_output: Design read with subject/audience, distinctive type and palette choices, hero tied to fashion/luxury brief.
assertions: States a concrete design direction before implementation
Avoids default purple gradient SaaS hero cliché without justification
Typography pairing is intentional not Inter/Roboto-only default
Scope is storefront/marketing not admin dashboard

evals.name: reject-admin-scope
evals.prompt: Apply frontend-design skill to redesign the /dashboard/brands admin table page.
evals.expected_output: Redirects to admin patterns — layout-typography, tanstack-table, shadcn — not landing-page aesthetics.
assertions: Does not treat admin CRUD table as landing page redesign
Points to appropriate Luxe admin skills or components
